title: peer-contract v0.1 - Dispatch Routing
description: Core dispatch routing: explicit target_session_key, dispatch_id, dialog_key, source/target role. Solves core problem #1 (explicit routing) - prevents default-to-main and allows downstream rules (HR1, HR6) to validate routing intent.

dispatch_id.description: Unique ID for this dispatch. Generated by sender. Used for tracing, replay, AC chain references.

dialog_key.description: Logical dialog/conversation identifier. All dispatches in the same conversation share dialog_key. Used by recipient to thread context (without leaking session context across session boundaries - see isolation schema).

source_session_key.description: Sender session key. Must be a valid session key. Plugin/runtime uses this to infer sender_role (cross-checked against source_role claim).

target_session_key.description: Recipient session key. REQUIRED, no default. HR1 (no-default-to-main) and HR6 (session existence) enforced against this field.

source_role.description: Sender's role. Should match inferred role from source_session_key. Plugin enforces this cross-check.

target_role.description: Recipient's role. HR2 (no cross-work direct) and HR3 (no user-to-work) enforced against this combination with source_role.

timestamp.description: ISO8601 dispatch creation time. Sender's clock. Used for ordering and TTL.

intent.description: Semantic intent. Drives bus flow selection (see 04-bus.schema.json).

in_reply_to.description: If this dispatch is a reply, points to the dispatch_id of the original. Forms the conversation tree.

allOf.description: Cross-field invariants: HR1 + HR2 + HR3 + work-session restrictions

then.description: HR2: work session cannot dispatch directly to another work session - must go through bus
HR3: target=work requires explicit bus-relay path OR main-issued dispatch. Channel-originated → work blocked at runtime via messageProvider field.

allOf.description: HR1: target=main is only allowed for explicit non-routing intents (inform, query). task_assignment + main target = blocked.
